body:
Testing with DMT
I have always been interested in pharmacology, and I have heard from other trip reports that when you consume cannabis when you do dmt, it can prolong the effects, and nicotiana tabacum (the most common form of tobacco found in cigarettes) contains a small amount of harmala alkaoids (1 gram of nicotiana tabacum containing about 5mgs of harmala alkaloids, with about 120mgs being a dose that will have maoi effects), and so with this information in mind, I wanted to do a test to see how these substances can prolong the effects of dmt. Here is how I conducted the tests:
I consume a dose of 40mgs through a bong, with an effiency of about 30-40% of the dmt being inhaled, except for where I'm not taking it with cannabis, and I'll use a meth pipe, and smoke 15mgs of dmt. Weights can be off by + or - 5mgs.
I wait 1 week per dose to allow my serotonin receptors to get back to the level where I can get an accurate reading of how it will effect me.
On the days that I'm testing the other subtances, I will refrain from using it throughout the day, and will refrain from using the other substance to get an accurate test result.
This is my findings.
Week 1: after waiting a week after last doing dmt, I have chosen to do a dose of dmt without having anything else in my system. At around 1 am, I had my dose. The effects were relatively strong (psychedelic patterns forming when my eyes are closed, visual distortions on objects with my eyes open), and I felt fully enveloped by the experience for about 5 minutes, afterwards the effects lingered for about another 10 minutes, and becoming unnoticable.
Finding 1, no cannabis, no tobacco, 15 mgs of dmt, effects last for about 15 minutes, relatively intense oev and cev.
Week 2: on this day, I have decided to only smoke cannabis throughout the day, and smoke it with the dmt in my bong. On this night, at about 12 am, I had consumed it, and the effects were instantly felt different, I felt more sedated, and the visuals were slightly different. The effects lasted about 30 minutes.
Finding 2: 100mgs thc (400mgs of cannabis flower) and smoking throughout the day, no tobacco, 40mgs of dmt, effects last for about 30 minutes, visuals are mostly the same, with slight differences. Oev and cev are both present.
Week 3: during this day, I only smoked cigarettes throughout the day, and when it was around 1:30 am, I decided to dose. I had about 4 cigarettes beforehand, before smoking it. The effects were about as intense as they were without anything else, but after the peak finished, the lingering effects lasted for about 2-3 hours, but were not psychedelic, rather my thinking was off and I did not think the way I do when I'm sober.
Finding 3: no cannabis, 4 cigarettes before hand, and smoking throughout the day, 15 mgs of dmt, peak effects lasted 15-20 minutes, visuals are identical to having only dmt, but the after effects last for 2-3 hours instead of 10 minutes.
Week 4: for the final week, I smoked how I usually do throughout the day, smoking both cannabis and tobacco, and I decided to dose at around 1 am. The visuals were similar to how they are when consuming cannabis, and the peak lasted for about 30-45 minutes, and afterwards the after effects lasted for the rest of the night, and through about halfway through the next day.
Finding 4: 100mgs cannabis at dosing, 4 cigarettes at dosing, smoking both throughout the day, 40 mgs of dmt, peak effects last for about 30-45 minutes, visuals were similar to when I had the dmt with just the cannabis, the after effects lasted for about 14 hours, being mostly just a difference in thinking, and non visuals.
These findings are not going to be the same with everyone, everyones brain chemistry is different, and will lead to different effects, and how these substances work together. This is also not a scientific study, rather it is purely anecdotal.
I take other medications as well, which may alter the findings. These medications include gabapentin, propanolol, and hydroxyzine. I also drink alcohol.
